# Metrics Reference

> [!CAUTION]
> Commands and settings on this page can change or delete data and affect running deployments. Try them on a test or staging deployment first, and read the [disclaimer](../README.md#disclaimer). The guide is provided "as is", without warranty.

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_reference.py from Apache Airflow 3.4.0 (commit `d589193b35`). Do not edit by hand. -->

> **Generated page.** Built from [`shared/observability/src/airflow_shared/observability/metrics/metrics_template.yaml`](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/v3-4-stable/shared/observability/src/airflow_shared/observability/metrics/metrics_template.yaml) in Apache Airflow 3.4.0 (commit `d589193b35`). Descriptions are taken from the Airflow source (Apache-2.0) and may be shortened or reformatted. Regenerate with `tools/gen_reference.py`; see [tools/README.md](../tools/README.md).

Every metric Airflow core emits: 147 in all 77 counters, 39 gauges, 31 timers. Turn them on with `[metrics] statsd_on` or `[metrics] otel_on`, and see [Monitoring and Observability](../06_operations_and_housekeeping/03_monitoring_and_observability.md) for which ones to alert on.

* **Name** is the metric name with tags (StatsD with Datadog tags, or OpenTelemetry attributes). Names are prefixed with `[metrics] statsd_prefix` / `otel_prefix` (default `airflow`).
* **Legacy name** is the older form with the variables embedded in the name. It is emitted as well while `[metrics] legacy_names_on` is `True`; `-` means there is no legacy form.
* `{placeholders}` are filled in at run time.

## Counters

| Name | Legacy name | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `api_server.dag_bag.cache_clear` | - | Number of times the DBDagBag cache was cleared in the API server |
| `api_server.dag_bag.cache_hit` | - | Number of cache hits when retrieving SerializedDAG from DBDagBag in the API server |
| `api_server.dag_bag.cache_miss` | - | Number of cache misses when retrieving SerializedDAG from DBDagBag in the API server |
| `asset.triggered_dagruns` | - | Number of Dag runs triggered by an asset update |
| `asset.updates` | - | Number of updated assets |
| `asset_state_store.delete` | - | Number of times a task deleted a single key from the asset state store. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `asset_state_store.read_absent` | - | Number of times a task read a key from the asset state store and found nothing. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `asset_state_store.read_found` | - | Number of times a task read a key from the asset state store and found a value. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `asset_state_store.write` | - | Number of times a task wrote a key to the asset state store. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `celery.execute_command.failure` | - | Number of non-zero exit code from Celery task. |
| `celery.task_timeout_error` | - | Number of `AirflowTaskTimeout` errors raised when publishing Task to Celery Broker. |
| `common_ai.tool_calls` | - | Number of calls to a toolset of the common.ai provider. Metric with toolset (the toolset class), framework (`pydantic_ai`, `strands`, `adk`, `langchain` or `none`) and outcome (`executed`, `failed` or `replayed`) tagging. |
| `connection_test.failed` | - | Number of worker-dispatched connection tests that completed with a failure. |
| `connection_test.reaped` | - | Number of stale connection tests marked failed by the scheduler reaper. Metric with prior_state tagging. |
| `connection_test.success` | - | Number of worker-dispatched connection tests that completed successfully. |
| `dag.callback_exceptions` | - | Number of exceptions raised from Dag callbacks. When this happens, it means Dag callback is not working. Metric with dag_id tagging |
| `dag.serialization.version_created` | `dag.serialization.version_created.{dag_id}.{bundle_name}` | Number of times a Dag was serialized into a new Dag version, on its first serialization or when its latest version already has task instances. Metric with dag_id and bundle_name tagging. |
| `dag.serialization.version_updated` | `dag.serialization.version_updated.{dag_id}.{bundle_name}` | Number of times a Dag was serialized over its latest Dag version in place, without creating a new version, because that version has no task instances. Metric with dag_id and bundle_name tagging. |
| `dag_processing.callback_only_count` | - | Number of DAG file processing runs that processed callbacks only, without full DAG parsing |
| `dag_processing.file_path_queue_update_count` | - | Number of times we've scanned the filesystem and queued all existing Dags |
| `dag_processing.other_callback_count` | - | Number of non-SLA callbacks received |
| `dag_processing.processes` | - | Relative number of currently running Dag parsing processes (ie this delta is negative when, since the last metric was sent, processes have completed). Metric with file_path, bundle_name, and action tagging, and team_name tagging in multi-team mode. |
| `dag_processing.processor_timeouts` | - | Number of file processors that have been killed due to taking too long. Metric with file_path and bundle_name tagging, and team_name tagging in multi-team mode. |
| `dag_processor_heartbeat` | - | Standalone Dag processor heartbeats |
| `deadline_alerts.deadline_created` | - | Number of deadline alerts created for a Dag run |
| `deadline_alerts.deadline_creation_failed` | - | Number of deadline alerts skipped because their deadline could not be created |
| `deadline_alerts.deadline_missed` | - | Number of deadline alerts that fired because a Dag run missed its deadline |
| `deadline_alerts.deadline_not_missed` | - | Number of deadline records deleted because the Dag run finished before the deadline |
| `edge_worker.heartbeat_count` | `edge_worker.heartbeat_count.{worker_name}` | Number heartbeats in an edge worker. |
| `edge_worker.ti.finish` | `edge_worker.ti.finish.{queue}.{state}.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of task instances finished on an edge worker. |
| `edge_worker.ti.start` | `edge_worker.ti.start.{queue}.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of task instances started on an edge worker. |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_creation_status` | - | Number of Kubernetes create_namespaced_pod calls from the Kubernetes Executor, tagged by HTTP response status (`200` on success, the `ApiException` status code on failure, `error` for non-API exceptions). |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_deletion_status` | - | Number of Kubernetes delete_namespaced_pod calls from the Kubernetes Executor, tagged by HTTP response status (`200` on success, the `ApiException` status code on failure). |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_patching_status` | - | Number of Kubernetes patch_namespaced_pod calls from the Kubernetes Executor, tagged by HTTP response status (`200` on success, the `ApiException` status code on failure). |
| `managed_agent.failover` | - | Number of failover transitions inside a `FailoverManagedAgentClient` group, emitted once each time a member fails and the next one is tried. Metric with from_platform and to_platform tagging; a platform reads `unknown` when that member's identity could not be resolved. |
| `managed_agent.served` | - | Number of managed agent invocations answered through a managed-agent toolset, emitted once per answer. Metric with tool and platform tagging; a toolset over a failover group reports the platform as `failover`, and platform is the literal string `unknown` when the agent's identity fails to resolve -- a connection lookup failing, or a bug in the subclass's own `agent_ref` implementation -- a case in which the call still proceeds after logging a warning. Read next to `managed_agent.failover`, which records each transition by platform. |
| `ol.emit.failed` | - | Number of failed OpenLineage event emit attempts |
| `operator_failures` | `operator_failures_{operator_name}` | Operator `{operator_name}` failures. |
| `operator_successes` | `operator_successes_{operator_name}` | Operator `{operator_name}` successes. |
| `previously_succeeded` | - | Number of previously succeeded task instances. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `resumable_job.already_succeeded` | - | Number of times a ResumableJobMixin operator found a stored run ID whose job had already completed successfully and skipped resubmission. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `resumable_job.fresh_submit` | - | Number of times a ResumableJobMixin operator submitted a fresh job with no prior run ID stored (first run). Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `resumable_job.reconnect_attempt` | - | Number of times a ResumableJobMixin operator found a stored run ID on retry and attempted to reconnect. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `resumable_job.reconnect_success` | - | Number of times a ResumableJobMixin operator successfully reconnected to an active job on retry. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `resumable_job.terminal_resubmit` | - | Number of times a ResumableJobMixin operator found a stored run ID whose job was in a terminal (failed) state and submitted a fresh job. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `scheduler.critical_section_busy` | - | Count of times a scheduler process tried to get a lock on the critical section (needed to send tasks to the executor) and found it locked by another process. |
| `scheduler.dag_bag.cache_clear` | - | Number of times the DBDagBag cache was cleared in the scheduler |
| `scheduler.dag_bag.cache_hit` | - | Number of cache hits when retrieving SerializedDAG from DBDagBag in the scheduler |
| `scheduler.dag_bag.cache_miss` | - | Number of cache misses when retrieving SerializedDAG from DBDagBag in the scheduler |
| `scheduler.executor_events.failed` | - | Number of times `process_executor_events` raised an exception. Metric with exception_class tagging. |
| `scheduler.executor_events.processed` | - | Number of executor events processed per `process_executor_events` call. |
| `scheduler.loop_exceptions` | - | Number of times the scheduler loop exited with an unhandled exception. Metric with exception_class tagging. |
| `scheduler.orphaned_tasks.adopted` | - | Number of Orphaned tasks adopted by the Scheduler |
| `scheduler.orphaned_tasks.cleared` | - | Number of Orphaned tasks cleared by the Scheduler |
| `scheduler.tasks.killed_externally` | - | Number of tasks killed externally. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `scheduler.zombies.detected` | - | Number of zombie task instances detected by the Scheduler. Metric with reason tagging (`heartbeat_timeout`). |
| `scheduler_heartbeat` | - | Scheduler heartbeats |
| `task_instance_created` | `task_instance_created_{task_type}` | Number of tasks instances created for a given Operator. Metric with dag_id and run_type tagging. |
| `task_instances_without_heartbeats_killed` | - | Task instances without heartbeats killed. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `task_removed_from_dag` | `task_removed_from_dag.{dag_id}` | Number of tasks removed for a given Dag (i.e. task no longer exists in Dag). Metric with dag_id and run_type tagging. |
| `task_restored_to_dag` | `task_restored_to_dag.{dag_id}` | Number of tasks restored for a given Dag (i.e. task instance which was previously in REMOVED state in the DB is added to Dag file). Metric with dag_id and run_type tagging. |
| `task_state_store.clear` | - | Number of times a task cleared every key in its task state store scope. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `task_state_store.delete` | - | Number of times a task deleted a single key from the task state store. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `task_state_store.read_absent` | - | Number of times a task read a key from the task state store and found nothing. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `task_state_store.read_found` | - | Number of times a task read a key from the task state store and found a value. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `task_state_store.write` | - | Number of times a task wrote a key to the task state store. Counts each call, so one task may contribute several. Metric with operator, dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `ti.finish` | `ti.finish.{dag_id}.{task_id}.{state}` | Number of completed task in a given Dag. Similar to {job_name}_end but for task. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `ti.start` | `ti.start.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of started task in a given Dag. Similar to {job_name}_start but for task. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `ti_failures` | - | Overall task instances failures. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `ti_successes` | - | Overall task instances successes. Metric with dag_id and task_id tagging. |
| `triggerer_heartbeat` | - | Triggerer heartbeats |
| `triggers.blocked_main_thread` | - | Number of triggers that blocked the main thread (likely due to not being fully asynchronous) |
| `triggers.failed` | - | Number of triggers that errored before they could fire an event |
| `triggers.succeeded` | - | Number of triggers that have fired at least one event |
| `{job_name}_end` | - | Number of ended `{job_name}` job, ex. `SchedulerJob`, `LocalTaskJob` |
| `{job_name}_heartbeat_failure` | - | Number of failed Heartbeats for a `{job_name}` job, ex. `SchedulerJob`, `LocalTaskJob` |
| `{job_name}_start` | - | Number of started `{job_name}` job, ex. `SchedulerJob`, `LocalTaskJob` |

## Gauges

| Name | Legacy name | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `api_server.dag_bag.cache_size` | - | Current number of SerializedDAG objects cached in the API server's DBDagBag |
| `asset.orphaned` | - | Number of assets marked as orphans because they are no longer referenced in Dag schedule parameters or task outlets |
| `connection_test.active` | - | Number of connection tests currently in flight (`queued` + `running`), sampled by the scheduler each tick. |
| `connection_test.pending` | - | Number of connection tests waiting in the `pending` backlog (queue depth), sampled by the scheduler each tick. |
| `dag_processing.file_path_queue_size` | - | Number of Dag files to be considered for the next scan |
| `dag_processing.import_errors` | - | Number of errors from trying to parse Dag files |
| `dag_processing.last_run.seconds_ago` | `dag_processing.last_run.seconds_ago.{file_name}` | Seconds since a DAG file was last processed. Metric with file_path, bundle_name and file_name tagging. |
| `dag_processing.total_parse_time` | - | Seconds taken to scan and import `dag_processing.file_path_queue_size` Dag files |
| `dagbag_size` | - | Number of Dags found when the scheduler ran a scan based on its configuration |
| `edge_worker.concurrency` | `edge_worker.concurrency.{worker_name}` | Concurrency capacity in an edge worker. |
| `edge_worker.connected` | `edge_worker.connected.{worker_name}` | Edge worker in state connected. |
| `edge_worker.free_concurrency` | `edge_worker.free_concurrency.{worker_name}` | Available concurrency in an edge worker. |
| `edge_worker.jobs_active` | `edge_worker.jobs_active.{worker_name}` | Number of active jobs in an edge worker. |
| `edge_worker.maintenance` | `edge_worker.maintenance.{worker_name}` | Edge worker in state maintenance. |
| `edge_worker.num_queues` | `edge_worker.num_queues.{worker_name}` | Number of queues in an edge worker. |
| `edge_worker.status` | `edge_worker.status.{worker_name}` | Edge worker status (expressed as Python logging level). |
| `executor.open_slots` | `executor.open_slots.{executor_class_name}` | Number of open slots on executor. Legacy metric only emitted when multiple executors are configured. |
| `executor.queued_tasks` | `executor.queued_tasks.{executor_class_name}` | Number of queued tasks on executor. Legacy metric only emitted when multiple executors are configured. |
| `executor.running_tasks` | `executor.running_tasks.{executor_class_name}` | Number of running tasks on executor. Legacy metric only emitted when multiple executors are configured. |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_creation_batch_size` | - | Number of worker pods created in one Kubernetes Executor scheduler loop. |
| `ol.event.size` | `ol.event.size.{event_type}.{operator_name}` | Size in bytes of an OpenLineage event by event type and operator. |
| `pool.deferred_slots` | `pool.deferred_slots.{pool_name}` | Number of deferred slots in the pool. |
| `pool.open_slots` | `pool.open_slots.{pool_name}` | Number of open slots in the pool. |
| `pool.queued_slots` | `pool.queued_slots.{pool_name}` | Number of queued slots in the pool. |
| `pool.running_slots` | `pool.running_slots.{pool_name}` | Number of running slots in the pool. |
| `pool.scheduled_slots` | `pool.scheduled_slots.{pool_name}` | Number of scheduled slots in the pool. |
| `pool.starving_tasks` | `pool.starving_tasks.{pool_name}` | Number of starving tasks in the pool. |
| `scheduler.dag_bag.cache_size` | - | Current number of SerializedDAG objects cached in the scheduler's DBDagBag |
| `scheduler.dagruns.queued` | `scheduler.dagruns.queued.{dag_id}` | Number of DagRuns currently in the `QUEUED` state. Emitted as a single aggregate value by default; tagged by dag_id instead when `[scheduler] dagrun_metrics_per_dag_id` is enabled. |
| `scheduler.dagruns.running` | `scheduler.dagruns.running.{dag_id}` | Number of DagRuns currently in the `RUNNING` state. Emitted as a single aggregate value by default; tagged by dag_id instead when `[scheduler] dagrun_metrics_per_dag_id` is enabled. |
| `scheduler.executor_events.batch_size` | - | Number of executor events in the batch processed per `process_executor_events` call. |
| `scheduler.tasks.executable` | - | Number of tasks that are ready for execution (set to queued) with respect to pool limits, Dag concurrency, executor state, and priority. |
| `scheduler.tasks.starving` | - | Number of tasks that cannot be scheduled because of no open slot in pool |
| `ti.deferred` | `ti.deferred.{queue}.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of deferred tasks in a given Dag. |
| `ti.queued` | `ti.queued.{queue}.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of queued tasks in a given Dag. |
| `ti.running` | `ti.running.{queue}.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of running tasks in a given Dag. As ti.start and ti.finish can run out of sync this metric shows all running tis. |
| `ti.scheduled` | `ti.scheduled.{queue}.{dag_id}.{task_id}` | Number of scheduled tasks in a given Dag. |
| `triggerer.capacity_left` | `triggerer.capacity_left.{hostname}` | Capacity left on a triggerer to run triggers (described by hostname). |
| `triggers.running` | `triggers.running.{hostname}` | Number of triggers currently running for a triggerer (described by hostname). |

## Timers

| Name | Legacy name | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `airflow.io.load_filesystems` | - | Milliseconds taken to load filesystem implementations from providers |
| `batch_executor.adopt_task_instances.duration` | - | Milliseconds taken to adopt the task instances in the AWS Batch Executor |
| `connection_test.dispatch_duration` | - | Milliseconds the scheduler spends dispatching pending connection tests to executors in a single tick. |
| `connection_test.hook_duration` | - | Milliseconds a worker spends running the hook's `test_connection` for a worker-dispatched connection test. |
| `dag_processing.last_duration` | `dag_processing.last_duration.{bundle_name}.{file_name}` | Milliseconds taken to load the given Dag file |
| `dagrun.dependency-check` | `dagrun.dependency-check.{dag_id}` | Milliseconds taken to check Dag dependencies |
| `dagrun.duration.failed` | `dagrun.duration.failed.{dag_id}` | Milliseconds taken for a DagRun to reach failed state |
| `dagrun.duration.success` | `dagrun.duration.success.{dag_id}` | Milliseconds taken for a DagRun to reach success state |
| `dagrun.first_task_scheduling_delay` | `dagrun.{dag_id}.first_task_scheduling_delay` | Milliseconds elapsed between first task start_date and dagrun expected start |
| `dagrun.first_task_start_delay` | - | Milliseconds elapsed between dagrun queued_at and first task start_date |
| `dagrun.schedule_delay` | `dagrun.schedule_delay.{dag_id}` | Milliseconds of delay between the scheduled DagRun start date and the actual DagRun start date |
| `ecs_executor.adopt_task_instances.duration` | - | Milliseconds taken to adopt the task instances in the AWS ECS Executor |
| `edge_executor.sync.duration` | - | Milliseconds taken for one sync heartbeat of the Edge Executor |
| `kubernetes_executor.adopt_task_instances.duration` | - | Milliseconds taken to adopt the task instances in Kubernetes Executor |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_creation` | - | Milliseconds taken for a Kubernetes create_namespaced_pod call from the Kubernetes Executor |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_creation_batch_duration` | - | Milliseconds taken to create one batch of worker pods in a Kubernetes Executor scheduler loop, covering both the sequential and the concurrent (`async_pod_creation`) creation paths. |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_deletion` | - | Milliseconds taken for a Kubernetes delete_namespaced_pod call from the Kubernetes Executor |
| `kubernetes_executor.pod_patching` | - | Milliseconds taken for a Kubernetes patch_namespaced_pod call from the Kubernetes Executor |
| `lambda_executor.adopt_task_instances.duration` | - | Milliseconds taken to adopt the task instances in the AWS Lambda Executor |
| `ol.emit.attempts` | `ol.emit.attempts.{event_type}.{transport_type}` | Milliseconds taken by an attempt to emit an OpenLineage event. |
| `ol.extract` | `ol.extract.{event_type}.{operator_name}` | Milliseconds taken to extract an OpenLineage event by event type and operator. |
| `scheduler.critical_section_duration` | - | Milliseconds spent in the critical section of scheduler loop |
| `scheduler.critical_section_query_duration` | - | Milliseconds spent running the critical section task instance query |
| `scheduler.executor_heartbeat_duration` | - | Milliseconds spent in `executor.heartbeat()` per scheduler loop iteration, tagged by executor class name so each configured executor is reported separately. |
| `scheduler.scheduler_loop_duration` | - | Milliseconds spent running one scheduler loop |
| `serde.load_serializers` | - | Milliseconds taken to load all serializer modules |
| `task.duration` | `dag.{dag_id}.{task_id}.duration` | Milliseconds taken to run a task |
| `task.queued_duration` | `dag.{dag_id}.{task_id}.queued_duration` | Milliseconds a task spends in the Queued state, before being Running |
| `task.scheduled_duration` | `dag.{dag_id}.{task_id}.scheduled_duration` | Milliseconds a task spends in the Scheduled state, before being Queued |
| `triggerer.batch_trigger_creation_duration` | - | Time in milliseconds spent creating a batch of pending triggers. |
| `triggerer.trigger_queue_delay` | - | Time in milliseconds between a trigger workload being queued and being processed by the TriggerRunner. |
